name: QFactory
description: QFactory is a Niels Bohr Institute spinout developing nanomechanical resonators for quantum sensing, quantum opto- and electromechanics, and quantum memories. Co-founded by CEO Dr. Eric Langman and CSO Prof. Albert Schliesser (head of the NBI Quantum Optomechanics group), the Copenhagen-based ApS (CVR 44133482) was selected for the BioInnovation Institute Venture Lab program as the only quantum-technology company in its cohort.
